tasks.DateCalculation: Calculate the date today based on the given date (Jan 21, 2011) and the number of days passed.

Questions.content: What is the basis for calculating the number of days passed since Jan 21, 2011? The TG does not specify whether today is a few days after or exactly one day after the given date.
